# Test-only fixtures

Nothing in this directory is installed as a runtime provider.

- `music-cover.png` is VelaPulse's own algorithmically generated gradient, generated by `generate_music_cover.py`; no reference artwork is included.
- LRC lines are short original test strings generated in temporary directories.
- `audio_tools.py` requires the isolated-test flag and a private state file. Tests prepend symlinks named pw-dump/wpctl to their own PATH; release code always calls the real optional tools.
- Wayland virtual input requires both the test flag and a marker in the private runtime. Never point it at a live desktop.
- `dbus-isolated.conf` deliberately has no ambient activation directories. Activation tests separately install only their own service fixture into private XDG data.
